description: Rubash source pin for niubash releases (rubash#827, conclusion B). Every release job fetches exactly this rubash commit into ../rubash -- where the [patch] path override in Cargo.toml deterministically picks it up -- and fails the release unless the checked-out HEAD equals rubash_rev. This is the source-level twin of winuxcmd-pin.json (niubash#312/#327): the bundled WinuxCmd was already pinned, but the compiled engine was "whatever rubash master HEAD was at build time".
notes: Recorded from rubash master 4c41e2c0 (2026-10-23, Cargo.toml version 1.4.3) — adds the #1181 bulk GNU-parity wave (112 fixes: procsub/trap/env/pattern families), #1182 (helper-parity gate), #1176 (local declared-unset env residue), #1180 (wait -p / coproc unbind), #1155 (trap trio: EXIT in comsubst/pipeline, global RETURN), #1122 (procsub real pids + line numbers), #1185 (musl/ohos libc::time_t deprecation allow — the rev that unbreaks cross-target checks).

Bumped to rubash master d15a02df (2026-10-25, version still 1.4.3): niubash master requires rubash::script_driver::run_script_with_history_at_line_offset_tracked (R1 grouped-reader exit-jump verdict API), absent in 4c41e2c0 — building niubash master against the old pin fails (niubash-runtime E0425).
NOTE: the rev includes #863-era lock self-entry discipline; rubash Cargo.toml version 1.4.3 must match this pin's rubash_version.

Bumped to rubash master 368353ec (2026-10-26, version still 1.4.3): carries rubash#1772 -- #[allow(unused_imports)] on the debugger session-core facade re-exports. The d15a02df pin contains the un-annotated facade, so a release build under -D warnings (the CI toolchain action's default RUSTFLAGS) fails on 4 unused-imports errors in src/debugger/mod.rs; the rev also rolls up the rubash master wave merged since d15a02df (through the fix7 locale2 slice, #1752).
Bumped to rubash master a9385b4c (2026-10-27, version still 1.4.3): integration refresh for the niubash PR integration round (this branch merged onto niubash master 4b164d34).

Bumped to rubash master 0e9f8d45 (2026-10-27, version still 1.4.3): rolls up the issue-clearance wave-1 merges through rubash#1827 (protocol carrier U+E31A) and rubash#1836, whose new stacker dependency also refreshes the root Cargo.lock in this bump.

Bumped to rubash master ab2372f6 (2026-10-27, version still 1.4.3): pin refresh on the namespace-bridge exclusion line (pathmatrix final ruling 2026-10-27 item (a)); rolls up the rubash master wave merged since 8fffc99e, through rubash#1855 (stacker target gate, which is what adds stacker/psm to the root lock). The bridge exclusion itself (rubash PR #1856) lands on rubash master separately and enters this pin with the next bump after it merges.

Bumped to rubash master 252ff19e (2026-10-27, version still 1.4.3): integration refresh riding the niubash#618 merge-up onto niubash master d7dcce57 (after #615); rolls up rubash#1848 (unused-parens lint fix in job_builtins), rubash#1850 (exec-seam fixes #1807/#1832), rubash#1855 (stacker target gating — unbreaks the aarch64-unknown-linux-ohos cross-target check) and rubash#1857 (history read silence #1852 + stale time pin correction #1854); the root Cargo.lock is refreshed in this bump.

Integration of niubash PR #617 (the #603 posix-loader branch) merged onto niubash master d7dcce57 (after #615) and then onto 87a3b70 (after #618): the pin stays at rubash master 252ff19e -- the same rev the #618 integration recorded above, which also rolls up rubash#1851; root Cargo.lock verified unchanged against this rev (cargo check --workspace --locked passes).

Bumped to rubash master a268db28 (2026-10-27, version still 1.4.3): integration refresh — this branch merged onto niubash master d7dcce57 (after niubash#615), superseding the 495cf86e pin that #615's own integration recorded. This rev carries rubash#1856, the namespace-bridge exclusion itself (spawn-boundary argv crosses verbatim for wsl/ssh/scp/sftp) whose entry the ab2372f6 note deferred to 'the next bump after it merges', plus the rubash master wave merged since ab2372f6: #1850 (exec seams: pipeline stage fd-1 rebind + tail SHLVL seam) and #1857 (history read silence + stale time pin correction). rubash Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock are unchanged across ab2372f6..a268db28, so the root Cargo.lock refresh from the ab2372f6 bump stands as-is.

Integration addendum (2026-10-27): niubash#618 merged while this PR awaited integration (niubash master 87a3b709, whose pin record stands at 252ff19e); this branch merged master a second time and the pin stays at a268db28 — rubash master HEAD and a descendant of 252ff19e — superseding that record. Root Cargo.lock was identical on both sides in this round and is unchanged.

Integration addendum 2 (2026-10-27): niubash#617 merged next (niubash master 49b391b7, its pin record also stands at 252ff19e); this branch merged master a third time and the pin stays at a268db28, superseding that record as before. Root Cargo.lock again identical on both sides and unchanged.

Bumped to rubash row-11 head bdc1d78b (2026-10-28, version still 1.4.3): 1.5.0 PLAN row 11 rubash half (PR #1893) — the --debug CLI frontend, WP-15 exception filters, canonical file identity, SessionDriver Drop disarm, WP-16 extension, and the Tier A/B signal faces (Executor::inject_signal / interrupt; script_driver::inject_console_ctrl_c / consume_background_wrapper_handshake) that this branch's M-3 migration consumes. NOTE: bdc1d78b is PR #1893's head, not its merge commit — the pin takes the merge commit in the integration refresh after #1893 merges, per the row-11 brief (PR-2's body names the same obligation). Cargo.toml floors (root + niubash-runtime) now state version = "1.4.3", equal to the pinned crate version — the floor is lock-enforced from this bump on; the literal "1.5" floor lands with row 13's version bump.

Bumped to rubash master b95d28ae (2026-10-28, version still 1.4.3): integration refresh — the pin takes rubash PR #1893's merge commit, superseding the bdc1d78b head pin recorded above for the row-11 pair, per the obligation both PR bodies name. Root Cargo.lock unchanged (the path-patch pin carries no lock entry; the lock already states rubash 1.4.3).

Bumped to rubash master 5b63c803 (2026-10-29, version still 1.4.3): the Session-contract pin — this rev is rubash PR #1986's merge commit, which publishes the 1.5.0 Tier A Session API (rubash::api: Session/SessionBuilder, RunOutcome/Flow, the section 5.3 state views, the section 5.5 capability traits, SessionEvents, value diagnostics, Tier B syntax views) in-tree. This bump is step 1 of the niubash Session migration (full-B step 2, rubash#1978): the niubash host's consumption faces move onto the contract in the commits that follow on this branch. The rollup since b95d28ae also carries the redundancy-cleanup wave (comsub admission dedupe, special-path convergence), the coproc ordered-redirect transplant (#1985), the pwd verbatim-prefix fix (#1995), and the debugger condition-report fix (#1979).

Bumped to rubash fix/684-ctrl-d-eof head d9a814a0 (2026-10-30, version still 1.4.3): the niubash#684 Ctrl-D engine fix — (1) a process-stdin EOF is a verdict, not a retry (the read acquisition no longer re-asks fd 0 after its EOF; the interop face where `read` at Ctrl-D hung, swallowed the next line, or took the shell down with it), and (2) canonical-console VEOF translation (a cooked Windows console delivers 0x04 as data; the read transports now give it the EOF/flush semantics a Unix line discipline would — the ConPTY face). NOTE: d9a814a0 is rubash PR #2166's head, not its merge commit — the pin takes the merge commit in the integration refresh after #2166 merges, per the row-11 precedent recorded above. Root Cargo.lock unchanged (the path-patch pin carries no lock entry; the lock already states rubash 1.4.3).

Bumped to rubash master 5d4b888a (2026-10-30, version still 1.4.3): integration refresh — the pin takes rubash PR #2166's merge commit, superseding the d9a814a0 head pin recorded above for the niubash#684 pair, per the obligation both PR bodies name. Root Cargo.lock unchanged (the path-patch pin carries no lock entry; the lock already states rubash 1.4.3).

NOTE: 76f611d5 is PR #2354's head, not its merge commit — the pin takes the merge commit in the integration refresh after #2354 merges, per the row-11 precedent recorded above.
